Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: wordless NexusPoint editorial still-life image, 1 of 9.
Primary request: A tangle of loose threads in silver, copper and pale wool lies coiled on a dark slate surface on the left, and each thread is drawn through a precise machined steel comb standing upright in the centre of the frame. On the right side of the comb only four threads emerge, perfectly straight and parallel, converging into a single small glass bead that glows Nexus blue (#02A1E1). The remaining threads stay gathered and coiled in front of the comb, set aside. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the comb sharp in focus, the coils softening into blur.
Style and composition: Photographic studio still life with real materials, soft directional key light from the upper left, a deep black backdrop (#000000) falling away into darkness, charcoal shadows (#060607), shallow depth of field around the focal point, fine natural texture, quiet and premium. Palette of true black, white and silver highlights and natural material tones, with Nexus blue (#02A1E1) used only on the single point where things connect, glowing softly. Wide 16:9 landscape with the subject held in the central third and calm space on every side. The image is wordless, shapes and materials alone.

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied steel-comb still-life image.
Change only framing and staging scale: pull the camera substantially back, keeping the same three-quarter view from slightly above. Show the entire loose coil arrangement, upright comb, exactly four outgoing threads and single blue glass bead as one compact group located within the central third of a wide 16:9 canvas. Plenty of quiet deep black negative space on all four sides. No threads or coils touch any image edge. The comb and blue connection point should sit close to the image centre, not near the edges.
Preserve: photographic real silver, copper and pale wool textures, slate surface, machined upright steel comb, exactly four outgoing strands (two silver, one copper, one pale wool) running straight together before converging into one small Nexus blue (#02A1E1) glass bead. Preserve upper-left soft lighting, charcoal shadows, shallow depth of field with comb sharp and coils softly blurred. Wordless; no letters, symbols, logos or watermarks.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied basalt-and-water still-life image.
Change only framing and staging scale: pull the camera back, preserving the low three-quarter angle close to stone-surface height. Show exactly two COMPLETE polished black basalt blocks sitting side by side as a compact arrangement held in the central third of a wide 16:9 canvas. Both blocks and the continuous channel must be entirely visible, surrounded by ample deep black negative space on every side. Nothing cropped at left, right or bottom.
Preserve: hairline seam centred between the blocks; one unbroken carved channel crosses the seam and carries a thin stream of clear water from left block to right block; a softly glowing Nexus blue (#02A1E1) accent ONLY at the seam crossing. True black, white/silver specular reflections, natural black stone texture, upper-left soft studio key light, charcoal shadows, seam sharp and distant channel ends softly blurred. Quiet premium photographic still life. No letters, text, logos or watermarks.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied paper-bridge still-life image.
Change only framing and staging scale: substantially widen the camera view so the entire arrangement is a small compact subject in the central third of the 16:9 landscape. Show the complete warm oiled oak plinth on the left and complete smoked dark glass plinth on the right, standing a short distance apart, surrounded by ample calm black negative space on every side, with clear dark margin below their bases. Maintain side view at the height of the plinth tops. No cropped blocks.
Preserve exactly one heavy cream cotton paper sheet lying FLAT across the gap, resting on both plinth tops. Keep it a flat paper bridge, with a faint white-silver line of light travelling from oak toward glass, ending in a single small softly glowing Nexus blue (#02A1E1) point where the paper edge meets the glass. Preserve realistic tactile materials, paper bridge crisp, lower plinths fading into charcoal shadow, upper-left soft studio key light and quiet premium photographic quality. No lettering, symbols, captions, logos or watermarks.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied glass-funnel and weathered-brass-pipe still life.
Change ONLY the pipe's central kink and sand-flow depiction. The brass pipe must be one continuous intact SEALED opaque weathered brass pipe from the glass funnel on the left, through a sharply bent and tightly PINCHED crimp in the centre, to the downturned open outlet on the far right. At the centre the brass walls fold inward and narrow the passage drastically, but remain completely intact and joined. The current image incorrectly shows a broken joint and sand leaking beneath it: replace that broken joint with intact crimped metal, and remove ALL sand beneath the centre.
Keep one soft Nexus blue (#02A1E1) ring around the intact central pinched kink. Sand is backed up in the clear funnel and only a very tiny slow trickle emerges from the open downward-facing end of the pipe on the FAR RIGHT, with a tiny pale accumulation directly under that outlet. Sand does not spill anywhere else. No transparent brass, cutaway diagram, labels or arrows.
Preserve the overall complete compact arrangement and generous dark margins, wide 16:9 landscape framing, new flawless clear glass funnel filled with pale sand on the left, old weathered dark brass patina, pure black backdrop, charcoal surface, upper-left soft studio lighting, quiet premium photographic real materials, blue only localized at the central kink. Wordless, no logos or watermarks.

validation.visual_review: All nine concepts inspected. Verified subject counts and localized blue accents; corrected cropping in images 1–3 and sand leakage in image 6.
